description: This file contains a JavaScript module that uses the 'pptxgenjs' library to generate PowerPoint presentations based on templates, slide data, and user input. It includes functions for loading assets, applying transformations, rendering slides with placeholders, fixed shapes, and handling images. The main exported function 'generatePptx' creates and returns a PPTX blob and filename.

methods.name: isProbablyDataUrl(v)
methods.description: Checks if a string is likely a data URL by testing if it starts with 'data:'.

methods.name: fileToDataUrl(file)
methods.description: Converts a File object or string to a data URL; returns null if not possible.

methods.name: urlToDataUrl(url)
methods.description: Fetches a URL and converts the fetched blob into a data URL.

methods.name: applyTransform(value, transformName)
methods.description: Applies specified transformations (e.g., percentage, currency, bullets) to input values.

methods.name: resolveDeckTitle(wizardData)
methods.description: Resolves the title for the presentation, prioritizing 'name' from globalFirst data or defaulting to 'presentation'.

methods.name: formatGlobalFirstLabeledLine(fieldId, rawValue)
methods.description: Formats lines for 'Name' and 'Date' in the 'Global First' slide according to specific rules.

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be a safe filename, replacing invalid characters, trimming, and limiting length.

methods.name: resolveValueForStep(wizardData, slideStep, fieldId)
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific field in a slide step from the wizard data according to scope.

methods.name: ptToIn(pt)
methods.description: Converts points to inches for positioning within PowerPoint slides.

methods.name: addFallbackText(slide, i, value)
methods.description: Adds fallback text to a slide at a specified position if the primary content is unavailable.

methods.name: addFallbackImage(slide, i, fileOrUrl)
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a fallback image to a slide from a file or URL.

methods.name: renderFixedShapes(slide, layout, templateIndex)
methods.description: Renders fixed shapes (including images and shapes) on slides based on layout specifications.

methods.name: generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData })
methods.description: Main exported function that generates a PowerPoint presentation Blob based on template data, slides configuration, and user input, and returns the Blob and filename.

ctags.name: generatePptx
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData/
